name: Executive Protection
title: Executive Protection & Bodyguards in Bangkok
metaDescription: Discreet close protection for executives in Bangkok: a suited, English-speaking bodyguard working with your chauffeur between meetings, hotels and dinners.
intro: Business in Bangkok moves quickly, and your attention belongs on the meeting rather than the pavement outside it. A SiamDrive executive protection detail pairs a suited, English-speaking bodyguard with your chauffeur, so every arrival, departure and walk through a lobby is planned and quietly covered.

paragraphs: Good close protection starts the evening before. Your bodyguard reviews your itinerary with your chauffeur: the addresses, the building entrances, which lobby leads to which lift bank, and where the car can wait without being moved on. Bangkok's office towers and hotels often have several entrances and a separate car-park approach, and knowing the right one saves minutes and avoids standing about on a busy forecourt.

Timings are agreed with a sensible margin, and alternative routes are noted for the stretches where traffic tends to stall — Sukhumvit at the evening peak, or the approaches to Silom and Sathorn when it rains.

Your bodyguard also notes the practical details that are easy to overlook: whether a building asks visitors to register at a security desk, how long the lifts take at nine o’clock, and where you can step aside for a private call between appointments.

Your bodyguard wears a dark, well-cut suit and carries themselves like a member of your own staff rather than an imposing figure at your shoulder. During meetings they wait in reception, the outer office or wherever your hosts prefer — close enough to rejoin you in moments, far enough away to leave your conversations private.

On foot, they move a half-step ahead through doors and lifts, keep an eye on who is approaching and politely manage unexpected interruptions, from an over-eager contact to a persistent street vendor. Nothing they see or hear during the assignment is discussed outside the detail.

sections.h2: One plan, shared with your chauffeur
paragraphs: Because protection is always booked together with a SiamDrive vehicle, your chauffeur and bodyguard work from the same schedule and stay in contact throughout the day. As a meeting draws to a close, the bodyguard lets the chauffeur know, and the car is at the entrance when you step out rather than circling the block.

Laptops, documents and samples travel with you or stay out of sight in the car with your chauffeur. If plans change mid-afternoon — a meeting overruns, a dinner moves across town — the detail adjusts together, and extra time simply continues at the hourly overtime rate.
For dinners with clients, the bodyguard checks the restaurant entrance and the route back to the car before you arrive, so the evening ends as smoothly as the working day.

Most business travellers need one well-briefed bodyguard rather than a visible entourage. For senior leadership visits or multi-day programmes we may suggest a second guard, and where several vehicles move together, motorcycle escort riders can keep the convoy in formation. Site visits on the Eastern Seaboard or further afield are covered too, with a supplement for assignments outside Bangkok.

Share your itinerary and any particular concerns privately on WhatsApp and we will recommend an arrangement that genuinely fits. No protection can remove every risk, and we would never claim otherwise; what careful planning does is reduce exposure and keep small problems small.

Itinerary review with your chauffeur in advance
Accompaniment from car to meeting room and back
Entrances, set-down points and timings planned
Transfer, five-hour or ten-hour details
Confidential handling of your schedule
idealFor: Senior executives on tight meeting schedules

Site visits and day trips beyond the city

faqs.q: Will my bodyguard sit in on meetings?
faqs.a: Not unless you ask. They usually wait in reception or an outer office, close enough to rejoin you immediately and far enough away to keep your discussions private.

faqs.q: Can the bodyguard carry my documents or laptop?
faqs.a: They can help with bags between the car and the venue, although most executives prefer to keep sensitive items in hand. Anything left in the vehicle stays out of sight with your chauffeur.

faqs.q: Can the same detail cover several days?
faqs.a: Yes. Many clients keep the same bodyguard and chauffeur for the whole visit, which builds familiarity with your routine, your preferences and the places you go.

faqs.q: Do you cover meetings outside Bangkok?
faqs.a: Yes. Site visits and day trips are welcome. A supplement applies for assignments outside Bangkok and is included in your quote before you confirm.

faqs.q: Who sees my itinerary?
faqs.a: Only the bodyguard and chauffeur assigned to you, and only for the purpose of planning and running the detail.

name: VIP & Celebrity
title: VIP & Celebrity Bodyguards in Bangkok
metaDescription: Suited, English-speaking bodyguards for visiting talent, public figures and influencers in Bangkok, coordinated with your chauffeur for calm appearances.
intro: When people recognise you, an ordinary walk from car to door can turn into a crowd. SiamDrive provides suited, English-speaking bodyguards for visiting talent, public figures and influencers, working hand in hand with your chauffeur so appearances run smoothly and private time stays private.

paragraphs: Recognition in Bangkok tends to be warm rather than hostile — a request for a photo in a hotel lobby, a small gathering outside a shopping mall, phones raised as you leave a restaurant. Your bodyguard's job is to keep those moments pleasant and brief: creating a little space, guiding you through, and declining politely on your behalf when you would rather keep moving.

Before the assignment, we agree the ground rules with you or your team. Are photographs welcome today, or only at the event itself? Who in your party may approach freely? How should a fan be turned away? With those answers settled, your bodyguard can act decisively without ever appearing heavy-handed.

The most exposed moments are usually the shortest: the few steps between the car and a door. Your chauffeur and bodyguard agree set-down points in advance and, where a venue permits, use quieter side or service entrances arranged with its staff. When you are ready to leave, the bodyguard confirms the car is in position before you step outside.
Pick-up times and locations are kept within the detail, and patterns are varied where it makes sense, so your movements are harder to predict from the outside.
At hotels, your bodyguard works with the front office so that check-in, room access and lift movements involve as little time in the public lobby as possible.

Talent rarely travels alone. Your bodyguard works with your manager, publicist or assistant as a single point of contact for movement and security, and liaises with venue and organiser security at events — complementing their work rather than replacing it.

Schedules for public figures change by the hour. Because protection is always booked together with a SiamDrive vehicle, a new interview, a later dinner or an unplanned stop is absorbed by one team that already knows the plan, with extra time at the hourly overtime rate.
Your bodyguard also keeps the chauffeur informed of any change at a venue — a larger crowd gathering outside, for example — so the car can be moved to a better collection point before you leave.

Our bodyguards and chauffeurs do not photograph clients, post about them or discuss who they have driven or accompanied. We also suggest small habits that help — sharing locations after you have left rather than while you are there, for instance.

For larger appearances we can arrange several guards, a second car and motorcycle escort riders to keep vehicles together. Tell us about the visit confidentially on WhatsApp and we will recommend a proportionate plan. Crowds cannot always be predicted, and no one can promise otherwise, but a well-briefed team handles the unexpected far more gracefully.
Where it helps, the same bodyguard stays with you for the whole visit, learning your preferences and your team’s rhythm.

includes: Suited, English-speaking bodyguard briefed on your agenda
Agreed approach to fans, photographs and approaches
Planned set-down points and quieter entrances
Liaison with your team and venue security
Coordination with your SiamDrive chauffeur
Strict discretion before, during and after
idealFor: Influencers and creators on content trips

faqs.q: Will the bodyguard stop people taking photographs?
faqs.a: They cannot control photography in public places, but they can keep moments brief, create space around you and politely decline requests on your behalf.

faqs.q: Can you work with our own security or management team?
faqs.a: Yes. Your bodyguard coordinates with your team and with venue or organiser security, so everyone works from the same plan.

faqs.q: Will anyone post about my visit?
faqs.a: No. Our bodyguards and chauffeurs do not photograph clients, share their movements or discuss who they have worked with.

faqs.q: Can you protect several members of our party?
faqs.a: Yes. For larger groups we arrange several bodyguards and vehicles, and motorcycle escort riders where a convoy needs to stay together.

faqs.q: Can the plan change during the day?
faqs.a: Of course. Because your bodyguard and chauffeur work as one team, new stops and later finishes are easy to absorb, with extra time at the hourly overtime rate.

name: Event Protection
title: Event Bodyguards for Galas & Weddings in Bangkok
metaDescription: A personal bodyguard for galas, launches, weddings and private parties in Bangkok, planned around the venue and coordinated with your SiamDrive chauffeur.
intro: Large occasions bring crowds, late finishes and a great deal happening at once. A SiamDrive bodyguard looks after you and your party specifically — from the moment the car arrives to the moment you are home — while the venue's own team looks after the event.

paragraphs: Hotels and event venues employ their own security to manage doors, guest lists and the building. That is not what we provide. Your SiamDrive bodyguard is a personal detail: their attention is on you, your partner or your guests of honour, not on the room as a whole.

They introduce themselves to the venue's security team on arrival so that everyone understands who they are and why they are there. The two roles work comfortably side by side, and you benefit from both.
If you are hosting, they also become a useful extra pair of hands: confirming that a late guest of honour has arrived safely, or that a car is ready for an older relative who wishes to leave early.

Bangkok's ballrooms, riverside terraces and rooftop venues each have their own geography. Before the event, your bodyguard and chauffeur work out the drop-off point, the route from the kerb to the room, any holding area for principal guests and the quickest way out if you wish to leave early.

Where possible, the bodyguard arrives ahead of you to walk the route. It is unglamorous work, but it means you are never led down a service corridor that turns out to be locked, or left waiting on a crowded forecourt.
Seating is worth considering too. A table with a clear line to an exit, and a spot nearby where your bodyguard can stand without intruding, is easy to request when the plan is made early.

Your bodyguard dresses to the occasion — a dark suit by default, adjusted to match a black-tie gala or a wedding dress code — and positions themselves at the edge of your group rather than in the middle of it. They stay out of photographs unless you want them in, keep an eye on bags and jewellery set down at the table, and quietly steer you away from conversations you would rather not have.

If a guest becomes overfamiliar or the room grows crowded, the response is calm and courteous: a word, a gesture, a change of position. The aim is that very few people notice anything happened at all.

Events tend to end all at once, and the forecourt fills with cars. Your chauffeur is told in advance when you are likely to leave, and your bodyguard confirms the car is at the door before walking you out. For weddings moving between ceremony and reception, several vehicles can travel together with motorcycle escort riders.

Celebrations in Pattaya or Hua Hin are covered too, with a supplement for assignments outside Bangkok. Message us on WhatsApp with the date, venue and guest list size, and we will suggest a proportionate detail. We cannot promise any event will be free of incident, but we can promise careful preparation.

includes: Suited bodyguard dressed to your event's code
Venue route, drop-off and exits planned in advance
Introduction to the venue's own security team
Personal attention to you and your guests of honour
Car positioned at the door for your departure
Optional escort riders for wedding convoys
idealFor: Hosts and guests of honour at galas
Private parties in hotels and residences

faqs.q: Will the bodyguard appear in our photographs?

faqs.q: What will the bodyguard wear?

faqs.q: Can you cover a wedding outside Bangkok?
faqs.a: Yes. Weddings in Pattaya, Hua Hin and elsewhere are welcome, with a supplement for assignments outside Bangkok included in your quote.

faqs.a: Yes. We can arrange several bodyguards and vehicles for a larger party, planned together so everyone arrives and leaves in good order.

name: Nightlife Protection
title: Nightlife Protection & Bodyguards in Bangkok
metaDescription: Enjoy Bangkok's rooftop bars and clubs with a discreet, suited bodyguard and your own chauffeur waiting outside. Planned evenings and safe late returns.
h1: Enjoy the Night, Arrive Home Safely
kicker: Evenings out · Clubs · Rooftop bars · Late returns
intro: Bangkok after dark is one of the great pleasures of the city, and the best evenings rarely follow a fixed plan. A SiamDrive bodyguard and chauffeur go where you go, so you can enjoy the rooftops and the clubs while someone level-headed keeps an eye on everything else.

sections.h2: A clear head on a long night
paragraphs: You are there to relax; your bodyguard is there to stay alert. They do not drink on duty, and as the night goes on that difference matters more. They keep an eye on your table and belongings, notice when a crowd or a conversation is starting to change, and move you on before a minor irritation becomes something more.

In practice this is mostly invisible. Your bodyguard stands where they can see you and the room, and steps in only when it helps — easing you through a packed bar, or making sure your party leaves together.
If anyone in your party feels unwell or simply wants to call it a night, the bodyguard arranges for them to be taken back by car rather than left to find their own way.

Tell us the outline of your evening — dinner on Sukhumvit, a rooftop bar in Sathorn, a club in Thonglor — and your bodyguard and chauffeur plan around it. They know where the entrances are, how long the rooftop lift queues run on a Friday, and where a car can actually wait on a narrow soi without blocking the street.
Plans change at midnight, of course. When they do, the bodyguard tells the chauffeur, the car is brought round, and the next venue is approached with the same care as the first.

Where a venue offers table reservations or a separate entrance for booked guests, it is worth arranging in advance; your bodyguard can then lead you straight in rather than waiting in a queue on the pavement.

sections.h2: Between the door and the car
paragraphs: The riskiest part of a night out is often the street outside: crowded pavements, persistent touts, the temptation to walk a few blocks or flag down an unfamiliar taxi. With your own chauffeur on standby, none of that is necessary. Your bodyguard confirms the car is at the door, walks you to it, and travels with you to the next stop.
At the end of the night, you are seen to your hotel lobby or residence door rather than dropped at the kerb.
Valuables are easier to manage too. Shopping bags, jackets and anything you would rather not carry can stay in the car with your chauffeur until you need them.

Our bodyguards wear suits by default; for some clubs a sharp, darker look blends in better, and we brief accordingly. They are courteous with venue staff and door teams, never judgemental, and entirely discreet about where you went and who you were with.

Groups usually need more than one bodyguard, especially if the party may split between venues. Share your plans on WhatsApp and we will suggest the right arrangement. Late nights often run long, so additional hours simply continue at the hourly overtime rate. We cannot make any night entirely risk-free, but we can make it considerably more comfortable.

Chauffeur on standby between venues
Entrances and waiting points planned in advance
Watch on your table and belongings

name: Airport Protection
title: Airport Bodyguard & VIP Arrival Protection Bangkok
metaDescription: A suited bodyguard meets you at Bangkok's airports and sees you through the terminal to your chauffeur. Pair with SiamDrive Fast-Track at Suvarnabhumi.
h1: Protected From the Moment You Land
intro: Airports are where travellers are at their most tired, most laden and most visible. A SiamDrive bodyguard meets you on arrival and stays beside you through the busiest part of the terminal, handing you straight into the care of your chauffeur.

paragraphs: For the smoothest arrival, combine your bodyguard with SiamDrive Fast-Track at Suvarnabhumi. Fast-Track assistance helps you through the airport formalities more quickly, and your bodyguard is waiting as you come through into the public arrivals hall — the point where crowds, name boards and offers of taxis all meet at once.
Both services are timed together from your flight details, so there is no gap between one team and the next and no moment spent wondering where to go.
If you are travelling with a larger party, more than one bodyguard can be arranged so that the whole group is met together and nobody is left to find their own way through the hall.

The arrivals hall is busy at almost any hour. Your bodyguard greets you discreetly — if you would rather not see your name on a board, we agree a code word or a simple description instead — and then takes the lead through the crowd, managing the trolley and keeping your hand luggage close.

The route from the hall to the car has been planned in advance, including the right exit and kerb or car-park level. You walk straight to the vehicle rather than waiting on the pavement while it is fetched.
Your bodyguard also keeps an eye on bags during loading, checks that nothing has been left on the trolley, and confirms the luggage count with you before the car moves off.

Your chauffeur monitors your flight and your bodyguard adjusts with it, so early arrivals and delays are absorbed without fuss. The two stay in contact as you clear the formalities, and the car is brought to the agreed point at the right moment.
If you are carrying valuables, travelling with family or arriving after a long-haul flight late at night, that coordination is what turns a draining arrival into a calm one.

For late-night arrivals, the route to your hotel is already chosen and the car is cool and ready, so the last part of a long journey is quiet and unhurried. Equipment cases and oversized luggage are worth mentioning in advance, so the right vehicle is sent and loading is quick.

Protection works just as well in reverse. Your bodyguard collects you from your hotel, travels with you to the airport and accompanies you through the public areas to check-in, where Fast-Track departure assistance can take over at Suvarnabhumi. Don Mueang arrivals and departures are covered by bodyguard and chauffeur in the same way.

An airport movement can be booked as a single transfer, or as the start of a five- or ten-hour detail that continues to your hotel, your first meeting and beyond. Send your flight number on WhatsApp and we will plan the timings around it. We cannot control airport queues or crowds, but we can make sure you never face them alone.

name: Family Protection
title: Family Bodyguards & Child Protection in Bangkok
metaDescription: A calm, suited bodyguard for families in Bangkok: an extra watchful adult for children at malls, attractions and hotels, coordinated with your chauffeur.
h1: An Extra Pair of Watchful Eyes
intro: Bangkok is a wonderful city for families, and a busy one. A SiamDrive bodyguard adds a calm, attentive adult to your group — someone whose only job is to keep track of everyone — while your chauffeur takes care of getting you from place to place.

sections.h2: Another trusted adult beside the children
paragraphs: Parents in a crowded mall have a great deal to manage: tickets, bags, lunch plans, and children who wander towards whatever catches their eye. Your bodyguard is not a nanny, but an extra pair of eyes focused on your family. They keep a running head count, stay between the children and the busiest flow of people, and help steer a small group through queues and escalators.
Before setting off, a meeting point is agreed at each venue and the bodyguard notes what everyone is wearing — simple habits that make a busy day much easier to manage.
Teenagers who want a little independence can be given it with a light touch: your bodyguard keeps them in sight at a respectful distance rather than at their elbow.

Whether the day includes Siam Paragon, ICONSIAM, an aquarium or a weekend market, your bodyguard and chauffeur plan the drop-off points, the entrances and the times when crowds are lighter. Large venues often have several car-park levels and entrances, and choosing the right one avoids a long walk with tired children.
When you are ready to move on, the car is called forward and waiting as you arrive, so nobody stands at the kerb in the heat while it is found.
Lunch stops and rest breaks are built into the plan, along with quieter corners of large malls where a young child can take a moment away from the noise.

Families rarely move as one all day. One parent may have a meeting while the other takes the children out, or teenagers may want an afternoon of their own. We can arrange a bodyguard and car for each group, coordinated so everyone knows where the others are.

Around the hotel, your bodyguard accompanies movements through lobbies and to the car, and can wait nearby during meals or at the pool if you wish. Because protection is always booked together with a SiamDrive vehicle, the whole day runs from one plan.
If a tired child needs to return early, we can arrange a second car so part of the family heads back while the rest of the day continues as planned.

Our bodyguards wear suits by default, though for a theme park or a hot day outdoors smart, practical clothing may suit better — tell us and we will brief accordingly. They are introduced to the children at the start, and most young travellers quickly treat them as a reassuring part of the trip.

Tell us about your family and your plans on WhatsApp, including any house rules you would like respected, and we will suggest a sensible arrangement. Day trips outside Bangkok carry a supplement. No one can guarantee a day without mishaps, but an extra watchful adult makes them far less likely and far easier to handle.

faqs.a: Yes. We can arrange a bodyguard and a car for each group, coordinated so everyone stays in touch.

faqs.a: Suits are the default, but for outdoor days we can brief smart, practical clothing that suits the setting.
